verses.text: A Song of the Ascents. Out of the depths I have called out to You, O YHWH!

segments.text: A Song of the Ascents. Out of the depths I have called out to You, O YHWH!

verses.text: O Lord, listen to my voice! Let Your ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications!

segments.text: O Lord, listen to my voice! Let Your ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications!

verses.text: If You were to mark iniquities, O YAH, O Lord, who could stand?

segments.text: If You were to mark iniquities, O YAH, O Lord, who could stand?

verses.text: But with You [is] forgiveness, so that You may be feared.

segments.text: But with You [is] forgiveness, so that You may be feared.

verses.text: I wait for YHWH; my soul waits, and in His word I have hoped.

segments.text: I wait for YHWH; my soul waits, and in His word I have hoped.

verses.text: My soul [is] for the Lord, more than those watching for the morning, watching for the morning.

segments.text: My soul [is] for the Lord, more than those watching for the morning, watching for the morning.

verses.text: Look with hope, O Israel, unto YHWH! For with YHWH is loving devotion, and redemption [is] abundant with Him.

segments.text: Look with hope, O Israel, unto YHWH! For with YHWH is loving devotion, and redemption [is] abundant with Him.

verses.text: And He will redeem Israel from all his iniquities.

segments.text: And He will redeem Israel from all his iniquities.
